title: Publish conserved budget account and settlement reducers
description: OBJECTIVE: expose the landed canonical conserved-budget transition authority through the real @moe/scheduler root so daemon code never copies arithmetic or deep-imports private modules. CURRENT GAP: the root publishes reservation and normalizeUsageMeasurement, but withholds the account-ledger and settlement closure (`openBudgetRoot`, allocation/return/replay/close, settlement/reconciliation/conservative close and their exact vocabularies/types). DELIVERABLE: curated type/runtime root exports plus closed namespace ratchets and compiled/plain-Node bare-root probes; no new budget behavior. HARD PREDECESSORS: task-7dc2e4870d7d4096a1be7b5991e50e94, task-a5def097bcb7495e935204bd845160b4, task-318c0732094c417f96932b5c83e7388b, task-5ee5b801127a4536a6e770abc6e83e9e, and task-3602672fd0c74de6b6fc72f90e1745c8 are DONE. CONSUMER: the daemon durable budget-ledger task filed after this task.
definitionOfDone: The @moe/scheduler root exports the complete account-ledger and settlement type/runtime closure, including exact code/roster constants and `openBudgetRoot`, allocation/return/replay/close, settle/reconcile/conservative/close functions, without exporting private helper internals.
The closed public namespace/type surface ratchets pin the exact additions and verify every runtime binding is defined while preserving existing reservation and usage-normalization exports.

Temporary NodeNext compile and plain-Node bare-root probes call one real account transition and one real settlement transition; an exact bogus-symbol negative control fails with the pinned TypeScript diagnostic, and all probes are deleted in the same command.
`pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test` and typecheck execute with nonzero Test Files/Tests counts, existing LF bridges remain byte-exact, and no reducer implementation is changed.
taskRails: Publication only: do not alter budget arithmetic, measurement coverage semantics, or expose `projectBudgetFact` as policy authority.
Record the daemon durable budget-ledger task as the real consumer; root export alone is not composition.
Use public symbol names remeasured from committed modules and preserve COMPLETE|PARTIAL|UNKNOWN without coercion.
Stage/commit only explicit scheduler root/ratchet paths and delete every temporary probe.

  1. "opens, funds, drains and closes a conserved account..." — openBudgetRoot -> allocateToChild -> deriveSubtreeTotals -> returnToParent -> closeBudgetAccount -> replayBudgetLedger, asserting exact bucket arrays (root 10/1000, child 4, root after 6/1000, child drained to 0), entries[0].kind === "ROOT_OPENED", child CLOSED, and replay-equals-state.
  2. "refuses a stale parent version..." — toEqual(["BUDGET_ACCOUNT_STALE_VERSION"]); the single-element array is a WHICH-LAYER assertion because duplicate-identity/unknown-account/counter-exhaustion all sit above the version fence. Paired with a second arm that must answer a DIFFERENT code (BUDGET_ACCOUNT_UNKNOWN_ACCOUNT), so a surface answering one code for everything cannot satisfy both.
  3. "settles an unmeasured reservation into a quarantined hold..." — real chain reserveForAdmission -> activateReservation -> settleReservation with `measurements: []`: state "QUARANTINED", the whole SettlementLine asserted by value (reserved 10 / committed 0 / refunded 0 / quarantined 10 / UNKNOWN_HELD / identity null / sequence null), settlementId === deriveSettlementId(reservationId), and the moved view buckets.

"refuses settling a reservation the root has not activated..." — toEqual(["BUDGET_SETTLEMENT_NOT_ACTIVATED"]) on a still-RESERVED record (identity is checked FIRST, so this names the guard that answered), plus a second, different code BUDGET_SETTLEMENT_ILLEGAL_CLOSE from closeSettledView over a still-quarantined settlement.
